belt_toolbag.name: Tool Belt
belt_toolbag.desc: Keeps your everyday tools close at hand. Expands the Hotbar to 10 slots.

bag_canvas.name: Canvas Backpack
bag_canvas.desc: Expands the Backpack to at least 36 slots; never lowers your current capacity.

fish_silverscale.name: Silverscale
fish_silverscale.desc: A common little Riverside fish in spring. Bites all day.

fish_grasscarp.name: Grass-Striped Carp
fish_grasscarp.desc: A Riverside fish in spring, on sunny or cloudy days from 06:00 to 18:00.

fish_bluecarp.name: Bluebacked Carp
fish_bluecarp.desc: A Riverside fish in spring, active from 08:00 to 20:00.

fish_spottrout.name: Spotted Trout
fish_spottrout.desc: A Mountain Stream fish in spring, on sunny or cloudy days from 06:00 to 12:00.

copper_ore.name: Copper Ore
copper_ore.desc: Mined on the upper floors of the Mines. Smelt 5 with 1 Coal into a Copper Bar.

coal.name: Coal
coal.desc: Fuel for the Furnace. The Blacksmith sells it too.

copper_bar.name: Copper Bar
copper_bar.desc: A basic material for tool upgrades and the Sluice Gate project.

clay.name: Clay
clay.desc: Found along the Riverside, and dropped by Moss Blobs in the upper Mines.

resin.name: Resin
resin.desc: A small by-product of trees in the Woods.

bugmeat.name: Bug Meat
bugmeat.desc: Dropped by Dirt Beetles in the upper Mines. Used to make Bait.

herb.name: Herb
herb.desc: A medicinal forage. Can't be eaten as is.

wild_greens.name: Wild Greens
wild_greens.desc: A common find in the Woods. Two make a Clear Broth.

wild_berry.name: Wild Berry
wild_berry.desc: Found in the Woods. Dry two into one Dried Rations.

mushroom.name: Mushroom
mushroom.desc: Found in the Woods. Dry it or cook with it.

dried_food.name: Dried Rations
dried_food.desc: Light provisions dried from two wild berries or mushrooms.

egg.name: Egg
egg.desc: A grown, well-fed chicken lays one every day.

hay.name: Hay
hay.desc: One a day for each animal; grazing outside counts too.

sword_old.name: Old Sword
sword_old.desc: Handed out at the Mine Entrance safety lesson. Attack 8.

rod_basic.name: Fishing Rod
rod_basic.desc: A basic rod lent by Shen Zhou. Fishes fine without bait.

bait.name: Bait
bait.desc: Only used up when a fish bites. Shortens the wait.

furnace.name: Furnace
furnace.desc: A basic smelter made from 30 Stone and 10 Copper Ore.

drying_rack.name: Drying Rack
drying_rack.desc: An airy food rack made from 30 Wood and 15 Fiber.

soup_clear.name: Clear Broth
soup_clear.desc: Simmered from two Wild Greens. Can be sold or handed in for orders.

roast_radish.name: Roasted Radish
roast_radish.desc: One Radish or Snow Radish roasted with one Wood.
